# Graphql attributes

Every attribute declared by `Graphql`, with the signature the code has and a usage quoted from the codebase.

## `#[ExposeAsGraphql]`

`Semitexa\Graphql\Attribute\ExposeAsGraphql`

Applies to: class. Repeatable.

| parameter | type | required |
|---|---|---|
| `field` | `string` | no |
| `rootType` | `string` | no |
| `output` | `string` | no |
| `list` | `bool` | no |
| `watchScopes` | `array` | no |
| `description` | `string` | no |

```php
#[ExposeAsGraphql(
    field: 'productBySlug',
    rootType: 'query',
    output: ProductGraphqlView::class,
)]
final class ProductDetailPayload
```
